basic_profile.bio: I'm a 35-year-old avid gamer and Pokémon Go enthusiast from Austin, Texas. By day, I work as a software developer, and by night, I'm usually hunting down the latest legendary Pokémon or diving deep into the creepy corridors of Resident Evil 2 Remake. I enjoy learning about new technologies and staying updated with the financial markets, which is why I frequently browse subreddits like SmarterEveryDay and Etoro. I am in a committed relationship and often play games with my partner. My online hours are mostly in the evenings and weekends when I unwind with my favorite games.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been working in the tech industry for over a decade. My passion for gaming began in childhood, growing alongside my interests in technology and software development. I am also self-taught in financial trading, which I explore as a hobby.
